repo.name: Megatron-Bridge

detail.body:
Qwen4-Exp can be built through `AutoBridge.get_model_config()` / `get_model()` as a Core HybridModel and converted with its vision tower. `text_only=True` selects the standalone language namespace, including the LM head, without loading vision tensors. LM and VLM share decoder construction and language modules.

This takes over Yuchen Wang's #6315, preserving every original commit and merge and adding the migration on top. Yuchen's Bridge-local QSA, gated residual, PLE and GDN/MoE implementation remains the basis. Casper Hansen's #6123 is the original conversion/model reference; this implementation does not depend on its unmerged Core changes. Neither original PR is modified or closed.

- Preserve complete attention/MLP blocks, layer indices, gated residual connections, PLE raw-token inputs and the learned final output mixer inside HybridModel/HybridStack.
- Use nested transformer/model configs and builders; remove unused legacy providers and redundant builder overrides.
- Convert the vision patch embedding, positional embedding, transformer and merger; use multimodal positions for attention and QSA pooled keys. Support sharded and native Transformers unsplit PLE tables, text-only selection and authoritative embedding tying.
- Skip the QSA indexer when the physical sequence length proves that all causal blocks fit the selection budget, retaining its checkpoint parameters and using the same dense attention backend. At the measured 2K length, the FLOPs estimate excludes skipped indexer projections.
- Provide a registered image-SFT recipe through standard `run_recipe.py` / `train.sh`, HF checkpoint loading and the shared Qwen VL forward step. The subset preparer lives under `scripts/data/`; there is no bespoke training driver.

The [image-SFT recipe](https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/Megatron-Bridge/blob/0759e54d8023df0842e366625eed4927ddbb43b8/src/megatron/bridge/recipes/qwen_vl/qwen38_flash_next.py) now defaults to the fastest combination in the completed comparison: **64 GB200, TP4/SP, EP64/ETP1, PP1/CP1, BF16, sequence 2048, MBS1/GBS16**, using **HybridEP**, fused permutation (including HybridEP permutation), router, bias/activation and gradient accumulation. Recompute, shared-expert overlap and CUDA graphs remain disabled. Routing remains natural; no forced load balancing was used. HybridEP requires its runtime backend and suitable NVLink placement.

**Early performance tuning; numerical equivalence remains unresolved.** The complete VL checkpoint `Qwen/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next` at revision `de4b8e4d43b917e7706784d8bb445c9af86a3540` was loaded in NeMo **26.10 RC4 (non-public release candidate)** with Transformers **5.16.1**, from runtime source `62f79249661338ea921f00d927d704bde10833cb`. The native Energon run completed **100 updates / 1,600 samples** from the prepared 8,192-sample Nemotron-Image-Training-v3 ECD subset. All 64 ranks completed with finite loss/gradient norms, no skipped updates, and actual 64-participant HybridEP domain checks.

| Native-loader TP4 result | Measured value |
| --- | ---: |
| Initial / final loss | 0.350771964 / 0.167497709 |
| Final-ten mean step time | 1,525.19 ms |
| Final-ten mean analytical TFLOP/s/GPU | 14.26 |
| Final-ten padded token slots/s/GPU | 335.695881 |
| Peak Torch allocated memory/GPU, steps 11–100 | 149.55 GiB |

The [verification card](https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/Megatron-Bridge/blob/0759e54d8023df0842e366625eed4927ddbb43b8/examples/model_verification_cards/qwen3.8-flash-next/card.yaml) and [recipe instructions](https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/Megatron-Bridge/blob/0759e54d8023df0842e366625eed4927ddbb43b8/examples/models/qwen/qwen4_exp/README.md) record this execution result. SFT verification denotes successful training execution, **not HF/backward/parallelism parity**. There is no input-matched native-loader baseline for a native throughput speedup claim.

Separate 40-update comparisons used identical authenticated predecoded samples, GBS16 and fresh full-checkpoint initialization:

| Configuration | Final-ten mean ms/update |
| --- | ---: |
| Original TP8 | 6,025.37 |
| QSA bypass, TP8 | 6,241.40 |
| QSA + HybridEP/fusions, TP8 | 5,191.28 |
| QSA + HybridEP/fusions, TP4 | 2,564.53 |

TP4 was **2.35× faster in this single sequential replay experiment**, with no recompute or OOM fallback. Timing varied substantially, so this is not a repeated steady-state benchmark. QSA alone showed no speedup. **Maximum loss difference versus baseline was 0.008722812 and maximum preclip gradient-norm difference was 28.2429**, exceeding the accepted `1e-5` threshold. Differences start at the first update, including QSA-only; their cause is not yet established. Profiled baseline intervals contain substantial collective activity, but this does not identify a specific module's critical-path cost.

The earlier TP8/GBS8 registered-recipe run remains historical evidence: 100 updates, loss **0.3097828 → 0.2084261**, **7.75 analytical TFLOP/s/GPU**. The original **5,349-step** VL run and its [loss curve/settings](https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/Megatron-Bridge/pull/6354#issuecomment-6160448312) also remain valid: 8,192 prepared image conversations reused cyclically, initial/final loss **0.31087 / 0.01342**, no recorded skipped/nonfinite updates. Gradient spikes remain unexplained. None of these runs establishes held-out generalization, checkpoint reload/export or resume.

Other verification remains scoped:

- **Conversion:** full in-memory language checkpoint import and full VL checkpoint loading passed; persisted checkpoint reload remains unverified.
- **Loaded-weight text pretraining:** ten steps passed on 32 GB200, TP8/EP32, with nonzero sampled optimizer-master changes and no skipped updates.
- **HF/Bridge/native-vLLM forward correlation:** all three pairs pass on the tested 64-token prompt; the 128-token EOS prompt remains below the standard 0.99 cosine gate (last-row cosines **0.986387 / 0.985372 / 0.985446**). Private HF-layer substitutions are diagnostic controls, not production parity fixes.
- The optimization allocation passed all eight exact CLI/finalized configuration variants and focused native model/config/data checks before loading weights. QSA's isolated forward/backward checks passed exactly; this does not resolve the full-model differences.

Current model limits remain **PP=CP=1**, no cached inference/padding masks, activation recomputation, CUDA graphs, FP8 or MTP. The unused selective-recompute extension is excluded from the final change. For a replacement VLM source with `text_only=True`, construct a fresh AutoBridge rather than passing the builder's replacement `hf_path` argument.

Shared supporting fixes include correct MoE counting for hybrid blocks; outer-config sequence length and dictionary vision FLOPs accounting; gated-residual/PLE matrix FLOPs; a reusable `train.sh --setup-script` hook; sanitized non-public RC provenance in verification cards; and offline pinned-tokenizer resolution. Analytical TFLOPS excludes norms, activations, lookups, PLE depthwise convolution, communication and duplicated parallel work; it is not hardware-counter throughput or MFU.

Publication checks: all-files pre-commit, 61 card tests, 59 standalone validator tests, and 21 documentation tests passed. Recipe metadata checks passed 41 cases with one unchanged, previously confirmed Nemotron registry-collision failure. Independent review checked model-source equivalence, recipe settings against the measured configuration, and verification claims. The updated recipe roundtrip test was not rerun in RC4; the card identifies the actual measured source and its override-based execution.

+# Qwen3.8-Flash-Next image SFT
+
+**Selected configuration: TP4 with HybridEP and fusions.** A 100-step native
+training run completed with finite loss. Same-input numerical differences from
+the earlier configuration remain unresolved; this is functional training
+evidence, not a parity result. Historical loss curves remain valid.
+
+The library recipe
+[`qwen38_flash_next_sft_64gpu_gb200_bf16_config`](../../../../src/megatron/bridge/recipes/qwen_vl/qwen38_flash_next.py)
+uses the standard training runner, Qwen VL forward step, Energon data loader,
+and HF checkpoint initialization. Language, vision, and projector parameters
+are all trainable. It replaces the standalone verification training script.
+
+## Prepare data
+
+Use NeMo **26.10.rc4** with Transformers **5.16.1** and tokenizers **0.23.1**
+for Qwen4-Exp processor/model support. These commands do not install dependencies.
+Download **Qwen/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next**, revision
+`de4b8e4d43b917e7706784d8bb445c9af86a3540`, including its processor assets.
+Use the same revision for preparation and weight loading. The recipe pins its
+model config, processor, and tokenizer to this revision.
+
+The preparation script reuses the existing Nemotron converter and selects the
+first **8,192 complete, supervised conversations** from the pinned ECD portion
+of **nvidia/Nemotron-Image-Training-v3**. Images come from
+**ChartFoundation/ECD-10k-Images**. Overlength conversations are skipped whole,
+without truncation; the output has 32 shards and no validation split.
+
+Run from the repository root, with portable paths supplied by the caller:
+
+```bash
+CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES='' uv run python \
+  scripts/data/prepare_nemotron_image_v3_subset.py \
+  --checkpoint /path/to/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next \
+  --source-dir /path/to/downloads --output-dir /path/to/prepared-ecd
+```
+
+Preparation uses four CPU workers and writes a manifest with processor,
+selection, and shard hashes. Existing subsets from the measured run are usable.
+Keep the pinned processor and preprocessing limits when reusing the subset;
+the standard runner does not replay the old driver's per-sample hash checks.
+
+## Use the recipe
+
+Within an existing 16-node allocation with four GPUs per node, invoke the
+standard runner once per node with the launcher-provided rank and rendezvous:
+
+```bash
+uv run python -m torch.distributed.run \
+  --nnodes=16 --nproc_per_node=4 --node_rank="$NODE_RANK" \
+  --master_addr="$MASTER_ADDR" --master_port="$MASTER_PORT" \
+  scripts/training/run_recipe.py \
+  --recipe qwen38_flash_next_sft_64gpu_gb200_bf16_config \
+  --pretrained_checkpoint /path/to/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next \
+  --max_steps 100 \
+  dataset.path=/path/to/prepared-ecd \
+  logger.save_config_filepath=/path/to/output/config.yaml \
+  logger.tensorboard_dir=/path/to/output/tensorboard
+```
+
+Create the output directory first. The
+[verification card](../../../model_verification_cards/qwen3.8-flash-next/card.yaml)
+uses the public `scripts/training/train.sh` launcher with this same recipe.
+Supply scheduler configuration through the launcher's normal external setup.
+Do not select a different `--dataset` preset: it would replace the prepared
+Energon dataset configuration. `--dry-run` resolves the launch configuration
+without allocating the model; it is not a runtime or correctness check.
+
+Defaults preserve the measured training settings: **64 GB200 GPUs, TP4/SP,
+EP64, expert TP1, PP1, CP1**, sequence2048, microbatch1, global batch16, BF16
+parameters, FP32 gradient reduction, distributed Adam with constant LR1e-6,
+weight decay0, clip1, and seed1234. The image limits are65,536–262,144 pixels.
+Sequences are unpacked and explicitly padded to2048. Auxiliary MoE loss and
+dropout are disabled. HybridEP flex dispatch and grouped GEMM are enabled with
+permutation fusion, permutation fusion into HybridEP, router fusion,
+bias-activation fusion, and gradient-accumulation fusion. Shared-expert overlap,
+gradient-reduction/parameter-gather overlap, recomputation, and CUDA graphs are disabled.
+No evaluation or checkpoint saving is enabled. HybridEP requires the 64-rank
+expert group to fit a supported NVLink domain; confirm placement and backend
+availability before using this configuration.
+
+The standard SFT path loads the full checkpoint and refreshes optimizer master
+parameters before the first step. Each step logs loss, pre-clipping gradient
+norm, skipped/NaN counts, iteration time, and estimated model TFLOP/s/GPU.
+TensorBoard logging is enabled when its output path is supplied. Save the
+runtime-synchronized configuration produced at setup entry and complete keyed
+step records. Record initial/final loss and average step time and TFLOP/s over the same final ten steps in the card;
+derive token-slot throughput as `2048 * 16 / (step_seconds * 64)`.
+TFLOP/s uses Bridge's analytical matrix-work estimate, not hardware counters
+or MFU. It includes GDN, dense attention, MoE, logits, vision, gated-residual
+and PLE projections. At the recipe's sequence length2048, the dense QSA path
+bypasses the indexer.
+Norms, activations, embedding lookups, PLE depthwise convolution, communication,
+and duplicated work across parallel ranks are outside the matrix estimate.
+Longer or forced-sparse QSA configurations warn that their estimate is approximate.
+
+## Recorded loss
+
+The original full-checkpoint run completed **5,349 steps in3h58m on64 GB200s**
+from Bridge commit `228077d7b63b13d8b3b7f276c78f53c8110c57ac`.
+Initial/final loss was **0.31087 / 0.01342**; first/last ten-step mean loss was
+**0.31155 / 0.01778**, with zero recorded skipped or nonfinite updates.
+The [loss curve](https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/Megatron-Bridge/pull/6354#issuecomment-6160448312)
+remains valid evidence from that run. It did not capture trustworthy TFLOP/s.
+
+A historical baseline run of the public `train.sh` command completed **100 optimizer
+steps** from Bridge commit `99188699f92108885b7f8823f87029369d2eb447`.
+Loss was **0.3097828 / 0.2084261**, with zero skipped or NaN iterations and a
+clean exit. Over the final ten steps, mean time was **1,403.24 ms**, mean
+analytical throughput was **7.75 TFLOP/s/GPU**, and derived token-slot throughput
+was **182.43 tokens/s/GPU**. These are early, unoptimized TP8/GBS8 allgather measurements.
+The 5,349-step run used the previous verification driver; its per-rank sampled
+gradient/update callback and deadline controller are not part of the library
+recipe. Repeated-subset training does not establish held-out quality or
+HF/backward/parallelism parity; historical gradient spikes (maximum230.02
+before clipping) remain unexplained.
+
+The selected configuration completed **100 native Energon-loader steps** from
+commit `62f79249661338ea921f00d927d704bde10833cb` with TP4/GBS16, HybridEP, and the
+five fusions listed above. Its explicit run overrides are now recipe defaults;
+the public command above expresses the same workload. Loss was
+**0.350771964 / 0.167497709**, with zero skipped or nonfinite updates and a clean
+exit. Final-ten mean time was **1,525.19 ms**, mean analytical throughput
+**14.26 TFLOP/s/GPU**, and padded token-slot throughput **335.70 tokens/s/GPU**.
+This native-loader run did not use canonical batch replay or profiling. It has
+no input-matched native-loader baseline, so these numbers do not establish a
+native-loader speedup over the historical GBS8 run.
+
+A separate 40-step comparison used identical canonical global batches at GBS16.
+Against its TP8 baseline, the selected TP4 combination had maximum absolute
+loss difference **0.008722812** and preclip gradient-norm difference **28.2429**.
+Differences began at step one and remain unexplained. Finite training and faster
+measured execution do not establish numerical equivalence. Recomputation stays
+disabled; this recipe does not claim qualified shared-expert recomputation.

+"""Prepare pinned ECD image conversations with complete, bounded Qwen VL samples.
+
+Run with CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES='' in a Bridge environment with VL dependencies.
+Pass a local Qwen3.8-Flash-Next processor/checkpoint directory; no model weights
+are opened. The default selects the first 8,192 complete samples in source order.
+The existing converter owns media resolution, message normalization, WebDataset
+writing, and Energon indexing.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import argparse
+import concurrent.futures
+import hashlib
+import importlib.util
+import json
+import logging
+import multiprocessing
+import os
+import pickle
+import sys
+from pathlib import Path
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+
+
+LOG = logging.getLogger(__name__)
+DATASET_REVISION = "7656391d4d4cb11ec3722b34f10d499435de0460"
+MEDIA_REVISION = "284489f140e56f253ac8c1bd76ce45ba8566c645"
+CHECKPOINT_REVISION = "de4b8e4d43b917e7706784d8bb445c9af86a3540"
+EXPECTED_ROWS = 55341
+PAYLOADS = (
+    (
+        "nvidia/Nemotron-Image-Training-v3",
+        DATASET_REVISION,
+        "ecd/ecd.jsonl",
+        441779670,
+        "e59a9a576fdc40beabe1b2467bba56547f413940c3df8b6777401ebfcbc0d28a",
+    ),
+    (
+        "ChartFoundation/ECD-10k-Images",
+        MEDIA_REVISION,
+        "images.tar",
+        1331769856,
+        "8ae3d9fb5b8345a17f4df420d50b662d5102cc54d46539870b0becad92c09cc1",
+    ),
+)
+SOURCE_FILES = (
+    "tutorials/data/energon/prepare_nemotron_image_v3.py",
+    "src/megatron/bridge/models/qwen_vl/data/collate_fn.py",
+    "src/megatron/bridge/data/conversation_processing.py",
+    "src/megatron/bridge/data/energon/task_encoder_utils.py",
+    "src/megatron/bridge/data/collators/sequence.py",
+    "src/megatron/bridge/data/collators/sequence_padding.py",
+)
+
+G_PROCESSOR = None
+G_LIMITS = None
+
+
+def sha256(path: Path) -> str:
+    """Hash one explicit file without reading it all into memory."""
+    h = hashlib.sha256()
+    with path.open("rb") as stream:
+        for chunk in iter(lambda: stream.read(8 << 20), b""):
+            h.update(chunk)
+    return h.hexdigest()
+
+
+def classify(*, length: int, supervised: int, alignment: int, limit: int) -> tuple[str, int]:
+    """Reject invalid supervision and skip complete overlength samples."""
+    if min(length, supervised, alignment, limit) <= 0 or supervised > length:
+        raise ValueError("Invalid sequence length/supervision/alignment")
+    aligned = ((length + alignment - 1) // alignment) * alignment
+    return ("overlength" if aligned > limit else "accepted"), aligned
+
+
+def _worker_init(checkpoint: str, limits: dict, bridge: str) -> None:
+    global G_PROCESSOR, G_LIMITS
+    sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(bridge) / "src"))
+    import torch
+    from transformers import AutoProcessor
+
+    torch.set_num_threads(1)
+    if os.environ.get("CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES") != "" or torch.cuda.is_initialized():
+        raise RuntimeError("Dataset preparation requires hidden, uninitialized CUDA")
+    G_PROCESSOR = AutoProcessor.from_pretrained(checkpoint, local_files_only=True)
+    G_LIMITS = limits
+    image = G_PROCESSOR.image_processor
+    if (image.patch_size, image.temporal_patch_size, image.merge_size) != (16, 2, 2):
+        raise ValueError("Unexpected Qwen3.8 image processor geometry")
+
+
+def _measure(item: tuple) -> dict:
+    from megatron.bridge.data.collators.sequence import prepare_sequence_batch
+    from megatron.bridge.data.conversation_processing import (
+        normalize_energon_vlm_sample,
+        normalized_vlm_sample_to_hf_example,
+    )
+    from megatron.bridge.data.energon.task_encoder_utils import videohandler
+    from megatron.bridge.models.qwen_vl.data.collate_fn import qwen2_5_collate_fn
+
+    key, messages, media = item
+    if len(media) != 1:
+        raise ValueError(f"{key}: this training path requires exactly one image")
+    # Match ChatMLWebdataset's actual image decoder, including float-tensor/PIL round-trip.
+    # Decode errors fail preparation; only complete overlength samples may be skipped.
+    images = videohandler("torchrgb")("sample.jpgs", pickle.dumps(media, protocol=4))
+    sample = SimpleNamespace(conversation=json.dumps(messages), imgs=images, videos=None, audio=None, tools=None)
+    example = normalized_vlm_sample_to_hf_example(normalize_energon_vlm_sample(sample), media_first=True)
+    batch = qwen2_5_collate_fn(
+        [example],
+        G_PROCESSOR,
+        min_pixels=G_LIMITS["min_pixels"],
+        max_pixels=G_LIMITS["max_pixels"],
+        require_assistant_matches=True,
+        sequence_length=None,
+        pad_to_max_length=False,
+        pad_to_multiple_of=G_LIMITS["alignment"],
+        enable_in_batch_packing=False,
+    )
+    length = int(batch["attention_mask"].sum().item())
+    supervised = int(batch["loss_mask"].sum().item())
+    decision, aligned = classify(
+        length=length, supervised=supervised, alignment=G_LIMITS["alignment"], limit=G_LIMITS["max_seq_length"]
+    )
+    # sequence_length=None above deliberately disables both truncation and padding.
+    # The exact native padding helper now adds only the amount of padding the training collator adds.
+    if batch["input_ids"].numel() != length:
+        raise ValueError(f"{key}: unexpected padding in single-example raw processor output")
+    prepare_sequence_batch(
+        batch,
+        sequence_length=aligned,
+        pad_to_max_length=False,
+        pad_to_multiple_of=G_LIMITS["alignment"],
+        enable_in_batch_packing=False,
+        sequence_tensor_pad_values={"mm_token_type_ids": 0},
+    )
+    if batch["input_ids"].numel() != aligned:
+        raise ValueError(f"{key}: collator alignment differs from selection")
+    grid = batch["visual_inputs"].image_grid_thw
+    if grid is None or int(grid.prod(dim=-1).sum().item()) <= 0:
+        raise ValueError(f"{key}: missing actual image features")
+    if int(grid.prod(dim=-1).sum().item()) // 4 > 2047:
+        raise ValueError(f"{key}: too many visual tokens")
+    return {
+        "key": key,
+        "decision": decision,
+        "sequence_length": length,
+        "aligned_sequence_length": aligned,
+        "supervised_tokens": supervised,
+        "image_sha256": [hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest() for b in media],
+        "image_grid_thw": grid.tolist(),
+        "visual_tokens": int(grid.prod(dim=-1).sum().item()) // 4,
+        "untruncated_collator_tensors": {
+            name: {
+                "sha256": hashlib.sha256(batch[name].contiguous().numpy().tobytes()).hexdigest(),
+                "shape": list(batch[name].shape),
+                "dtype": str(batch[name].dtype),
+            }
+            for name in ("input_ids", "labels", "loss_mask")
+        },
+    }
+
+
+def _source_dependencies(bridge: Path) -> dict[str, str]:
+    # Record the checked-out implementation without restricting users to one old code snapshot.
+    return {name: sha256(bridge / name) for name in SOURCE_FILES}
+
+
+def _load_converter(bridge: Path):
+    path = bridge / SOURCE_FILES[0]
+    sys.path.insert(0, str(bridge / "src"))
+    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("nemotron_subset_converter", path)
+    if spec is None or spec.loader is None:
+        raise ImportError(f"Cannot load the repository converter: {path}")
+    module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
+    spec.loader.exec_module(module)
+    return module
+
+
+def _emit_sample(converter, writer, item: tuple) -> None:
+    key, messages, media = item
+    converter._write_sample(writer, key, media, messages)
+
+
+def prepare(args: argparse.Namespace) -> dict:
+    """Download two pinned payloads, authenticate, select whole samples, and index."""
+    _validate_args(args)
+    from huggingface_hub import hf_hub_download
+
+    if os.environ.get("CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES") != "":
+        raise RuntimeError("Set CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES='' before preparation")
+    if args.output_dir.exists():
+        raise FileExistsError(args.output_dir)
+    args.output_dir.mkdir(parents=True)
+    source_dependencies = _source_dependencies(args.bridge_root)
+    converter = _load_converter(args.bridge_root)
+    local = []
+    for repo, revision, filename, size, digest in PAYLOADS:
+        path = Path(
+            hf_hub_download(
+                repo, filename, repo_type="dataset", revision=revision, local_dir=args.source_dir / repo.split("/")[0]
+            )
+        )
+        if path.stat().st_size != size or sha256(path) != digest:
+            raise ValueError(f"Pinned download integrity mismatch: {repo}/{filename}")
+        local.append(path)
+    jsonl, media_tar = local
+    # Count every source row cheaply, even though expensive image preprocessing stops at the accepted cap.
+    rows = []
+    identities = set()
+    with jsonl.open() as stream:
+        for number, line in enumerate(stream, 1):
+            row = json.loads(line)
+            sid = row.get("id")
+            if not isinstance(sid, str) or not sid or sid in identities:
+                raise ValueError(f"Bad/duplicate source identity at line {number}")
+            identities.add(sid)
+            rows.append(row)
+    if len(rows) != EXPECTED_ROWS:
+        raise ValueError(f"Expected {EXPECTED_ROWS} source rows, found {len(rows)}")
+    # Read authenticated tar members directly, without extraction or loose-file fallback.
+    limits = {name: getattr(args, name) for name in ("max_seq_length", "min_pixels", "max_pixels", "alignment")}
+    counters = {
+        "source_rows": len(rows),
+        "scanned": 0,
+        "accepted": 0,
+        "overlength": 0,
+        "eligible_after_cap": 0,
+        "unscanned": 0,
+        "invalid": 0,
+    }
+    lengths = []
+    with (
+        converter.MediaResolver(media_tar.parent, allow_loose_media=False, archive_paths=(media_tar,)) as resolver,
+        converter._make_shard_writer(args.output_dir, "train", 256) as writer,
+        (args.output_dir / "selection.jsonl").open("x") as selected,
+        concurrent.futures.ProcessPoolExecutor(

+                messages, media = converter._normalize_messages(row["messages"], resolver=resolver, sample_name=key)
+                batch.append((key, messages, media))
+            for item, record in zip(batch, pool.map(_measure, batch), strict=True):
+                counters["scanned"] += 1
+                lengths.append(record["sequence_length"])
+                if record["decision"] == "overlength":
+                    counters["overlength"] += 1
+                elif counters["accepted"] >= args.max_samples:
+                    counters["eligible_after_cap"] += 1
+                    record["decision"] = "eligible_after_cap"
+                else:
+                    _emit_sample(converter, writer, item)
+                    counters["accepted"] += 1
+                selected.write(json.dumps(record, sort_keys=True) + "\n")
+            if start % 256 == 0:
+                LOG.info("SELECTION %s", counters)
+            if counters["accepted"] >= args.max_samples:
+                break
+    counters["unscanned"] = counters["source_rows"] - counters["scanned"]
+    if counters["accepted"] == 0:
+        raise RuntimeError("No complete supervised image examples selected")
+    converter.prepare_webdataset(args.output_dir, {"train": "train-shard-.*"}, num_workers=args.num_workers)
+    metadata = args.output_dir / ".nv-meta"
+    metadata.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
+    (metadata / "dataset.yaml").write_text(converter.DATASET_YAML + "image_decode_spec: torchrgb\n")
+    files = {}
+    for path in sorted(args.output_dir.rglob("*")):
+        if path.is_file():
+            files[str(path.relative_to(args.output_dir))] = {"bytes": path.stat().st_size, "sha256": sha256(path)}
+    if sum(f["bytes"] for f in files.values()) > 8 << 30 or len(files) > 256:
+        raise RuntimeError("Prepared output exceeded 8 GiB/256 files")
+    if _source_dependencies(args.bridge_root) != source_dependencies:
+        raise RuntimeError("Preparation source files changed during conversion")
+    manifest = {
+        "schema": "qwen38-nemotron-ecd-prepared-v1",
+        "completed": True,
+        "dataset": PAYLOADS[0][0],
+        "revision": DATASET_REVISION,
+        "subsets": ["ecd"],
+        "media_dataset": PAYLOADS[1][0],
+        "media_revision": MEDIA_REVISION,
+        "reference_checkpoint_revision": CHECKPOINT_REVISION,
+        "checkpoint_revision_verified": False,
+        "counts": {"train": counters["accepted"], "val": 0},
+        "processor_assets": {
+            name: {"bytes": (args.checkpoint / name).stat().st_size, "sha256": sha256(args.checkpoint / name)}
+            for name in (
+                "config.json",
+                "preprocessor_config.json",
+                "tokenizer_config.json",
+                "tokenizer.json",
+                "merges.txt",
+                "vocab.json",
+                "chat_template.jinja",
+            )
+        },
+        "selection": counters,
+        "limits": limits,
+        "max_samples": args.max_samples,
+        "selection_policy": "source order; whole samples only; train-only; no truncation",
+        "length_range_scanned": [min(lengths), max(lengths)],
+        "source_integrity_verified": True,
+        "source_payloads": [
+            {"repo": r, "revision": v, "filename": f, "bytes": n, "sha256": h} for r, v, f, n, h in PAYLOADS
+        ],
+        "source_dependencies": source_dependencies,
+        "files": files,
+    }
+    with (args.output_dir / "manifest.json").open("x") as stream:
+        json.dump(manifest, stream, indent=2)
+        stream.write("\n")

+    return manifest
+
+
+def _validate_args(args: argparse.Namespace) -> None:
+    if (args.max_seq_length, args.min_pixels, args.max_pixels, args.alignment) != (2048, 65536, 262144, 8):
+        raise ValueError("This subset recipe requires sequence2048, pixels65536..262144 and alignment8")
+    if not 1 <= args.max_samples <= 8192 or not 1 <= args.num_workers <= 4:
+        raise ValueError("Choose 1..8192 samples and 1..4 CPU workers")
+    if not (args.bridge_root / SOURCE_FILES[0]).is_file():
+        raise ValueError("--bridge-root must point to a Bridge checkout containing the Energon converter")
+    if not args.checkpoint.is_dir():
+        raise ValueError("--checkpoint must be a local processor/checkpoint directory")
+
+
+def parse_args(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> argparse.Namespace:
+    """Parse portable paths and the validated complete-sample selection bounds."""
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
+    parser.add_argument("--source-dir", required=True, type=Path, help="Directory for the two pinned HF downloads")
+    parser.add_argument("--output-dir", required=True, type=Path, help="Fresh destination for indexed Energon shards")
+    parser.add_argument(
+        "--checkpoint",
+        required=True,
+        type=Path,
+        help="Local Qwen3.8-Flash-Next processor assets; model weight files are not read",
+    )
+    parser.add_argument(
+        "--bridge-root",
+        type=Path,
+        default=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2],
+        help="Bridge checkout (defaults to the checkout containing this example)",
+    )
+    for name, default in (
+        ("max-seq-length", 2048),
+        ("min-pixels", 65536),
+        ("max-pixels", 262144),
+        ("alignment", 8),
+        ("max-samples", 8192),
+        ("num-workers", 4),
+    ):
+        parser.add_argument("--" + name, default=default, type=int)
+    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
+    _validate_args(args)
+    return args
+
+
+def main() -> None:
+    """Prepare the pinned ECD subset using local processor assets and CPU workers."""
+    args = parse_args()
+    logging.basicConfig(level=logging.INFO, format="%(asctime)s %(levelname)s %(message)s")
+    prepare(args)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()

+# Qwen4-Exp hybrid language and vision-language models
+
+The model components live in Bridge and use the existing Megatron-Core HybridModel,
+GDN, attention, MoE, and hyper-connection interfaces. They do not require the
+model-specific changes to the pinned Core revision.
+
+`Qwen4ExpModelConfig` and its nested transformer config declare the checkpoint's
+QSA, gated residual, and PLE fields. `Qwen4ExpModelBuilder` builds an actual Core
+HybridModel/HybridStack with complete attention-and-MLP blocks. The model prepares
+raw token IDs for PLE and expands residual
+streams before the decoder. The final output mixer contracts those streams with
+learned gates; Core's generic mHC expansion and mean contraction stay disabled.
+
+## Optimizations
+
+- QSA scores document-local block keys without a query-sized replicated key
+  tensor. Query chunks bound the head-score workspace. The selected block
+  bitsets retain causal visibility and document boundaries.
+- GR keeps the HF activation-dtype division, sigmoid, multiplication, and mean
+  boundaries. BF16/FP16 gate helpers remain eager under an outer compile so
+  fusion cannot remove the reference rounding points.
+- Grouped RMSNorm saves the raw input and one inverse RMS per stream. Its
+  forward and first-order backward work in chunks, including the FP32 norm-gain
+  reduction. The 64 MiB chunk budget excludes required outputs, input gradients,
+  and saved statistics. A single row is the minimum chunk. Chunking can change
+  FP32 reduction order; it does not provide higher-order gradients.
+
+The grouped norm uses separate RMS statistics and zero-centered gains for
+each residual stream while keeping the flat checkpoint parameter layout.
+Normalizing the full flattened width would mix statistics across streams;
+reshaping streams into the batch dimension would share gains between them.
+The local implementation preserves both contracts and bounds reduction memory.
+
+## Supported scope
+
+The builder supports a text decoder with tensor and sequence
+parallelism, PP=CP=1, and no virtual pipeline stages. It rejects cached
+inference, padding masks, activation recomputation, CUDA graphs, FP8, and MTP.
+Use THD packing for document boundaries. Full VLM conversion includes the vision
+patch embedding, positional embedding, transformer blocks, and patch merger.
+The VLM combines visual embeddings before the hybrid decoder while PLE retains
+the raw token IDs. MRoPE uses each token's multimodal positions, including the
+QSA pooled-block indexer.
+
+When the physical sequence length proves that every causal block fits in the
+QSA selection budget, attention skips the indexer and uses the dense backend.
+This avoids indexer projections, pooling, selection, and its sequence-parallel
+gather while retaining all checkpoint parameters. Packed sequences use a
+conservative bound on their total length; `qsa_force_sparse=True` preserves the
+explicit selector path. With budget 2048 and compression ratio 4, the shortcut
+applies through length 2051. Analytical FLOPs exclude indexer projections when
+this shortcut applies.
+
+Use `AutoBridge.from_hf_pretrained(path).get_model_config()` to configure the
+model and `bridge.get_model(config, wrap_with_ddp=False)` to construct/load it.
+For a language-only view of a VLM checkpoint, pass `text_only=True` to
+`AutoBridge.from_hf_pretrained`. This filters vision weights and projects
+`model.language_model.*` to the standalone `model.*` namespace, retaining the
+root LM head; export produces a standalone text checkpoint. Native text
+checkpoints continue to use their existing namespace. Construction uses only
+Builder + Config; there is no separate legacy provider. When selecting a different
+VLM checkpoint for text-only loading, construct a new `AutoBridge` with
+`text_only=True`; the builder's replacement `hf_path` argument does not project
+a VLM checkpoint.
+
+The same public entrypoint selects either composition:
+`AutoBridge.from_hf_pretrained(path, text_only=True)` builds the standalone
+`Qwen4ExpHybridModel`; `text_only=False` builds `Qwen4ExpVLModel`, whose
+`language_model` is that same `Qwen4ExpHybridModel`. The VLM builder extends the
+language builder and delegates decoder construction to it. QSA, GDN, MoE, gated
+residuals, PLE and the output mixer have one implementation shared by both modes.
+The VLM reuses the existing Qwen3-VL vision encoder, attention, multimodal RoPE,
+input-reorganization helpers and Qwen3.5-VL vision mappings.
+
+Loading a Qwen4-Exp HF model requires a Transformers release that includes that
+model. Model parity tests use Transformers 5.16.1 in an isolated environment;
+the project dependency constraints are unchanged by this implementation.
+
+## Validation
+
+Run the focused numerical, mapping, and GPU conversion tests:
+
+```bash
+uv run python -m pytest tests/unit_tests/models/qwen/test_qwen4_exp_numerics.py
+uv run python -m pytest tests/unit_tests/models/qwen/test_qwen4_exp_bridge.py
+uv run python -m pytest tests/unit_tests/models/qwen/test_qwen4_exp_vlm.py
+uv run python -m pytest tests/functional_tests/test_groups/models/qwen/test_qwen4_exp_conversion.py
+```
+
+The functional test uses a small HF checkpoint and checks TP1/TP2 logits,
+packed inputs, embedding gradients, and HF export. Sparse-kernel acceptance
+also requires a sequence beyond the indexer budget, rather than only the dense
+shortcut. Component tests alone do not establish full-model training parity or
+an end-to-end performance improvement.
+
+The functional suite also includes a one-rank toy VLM/text-only import,
+forward/backward, and export smoke. It checks finite language, PLE, GDN, gated
+residual and vision gradients. The smoke uses the dense masked QSA reference
+backend, so it does not validate sparse-kernel performance. It checks a
+cross-entropy backward pass for finite gradients in each listed group and at
+least one nonzero gradient in each group; it does not compare HF logits, loss or
+gradients. Exact export checks parameter conversion, not execution equivalence.
+The separate text-only parity test above does compare HF logits/loss and word
+embedding gradients; these two test results must be reported separately.
+
+The H100 and GB200 L2 launch scripts run these GPU cases with at most two ranks. They install Transformers 5.16.1 in a temporary reference
+environment and reuse the container's CUDA packages, leaving the project
+environment unchanged. Each distributed case has a ten-minute timeout. L2
+requires the `full-test-suite` label or an explicit L2 workflow dispatch.
+
+## Sources
+
+The conversion mappings and base QSA/PLE/GR scaffolding are adapted from
+Casper Hansen's NVIDIA-NeMo/Megatron-Bridge#6123 and NVIDIA/Megatron-LM#7393.
+The local builder, model hooks, document-local scoring, bounded normalization,
+and gate-rounding changes are maintained in this branch. The gate-rounding
+change carries the earlier ModelScope contribution forward. Apache 2.0
+copyright and license notices are retained.

+
+from typing import Optional, Tuple

+import torch
+import torch.nn as nn
+from megatron.core.transformer.module import MegatronModule

+)

+
+def gated_residual_group_rmsnorm(x: Tensor, weight: Tensor, n: int, eps: float) -> Tensor:
+    """Zero-centered RMSNorm applied independently to each of the ``n`` residual streams.
+
+    Args:
+        x: [..., n*C] n-stream hidden states.
+        weight: [n*C] zero-centered gain (the effective scale is ``1 + weight``).
+        n: Number of residual streams.
+        eps: RMSNorm epsilon.
+
+    Returns:
+        [..., n*C] normalized streams in ``x.dtype`` (computed in fp32).
+    """
+    return grouped_rmsnorm(x, weight, n, eps)
+
+
+class GatedResidualHyperConnection(MegatronModule):
+    """Gated Residual hyper-connection of Qwen4-Exp (Qwen3.8-Flash-Next).
+
+    Every sub-layer (attention / MLP) of a decoder layer is wrapped by one instance. With ``n``
+    residual streams of width ``C`` travelling between layers as ``[s, b, n*C]``:
+
+        xn      = GroupRMSNorm(x)                                # per-stream, zero-centered gain
+        mix     = sigmoid(W_up silu(W_down xn / n))              # [.., n*C] element-wise read gate
+        block_in = mean_j(mix_j * xn_j)                          # [.., C]   sub-layer input
+        inject  = 2 * sigmoid(W_inject xn / n)                   # [.., n]   per-stream write gate
+        x_new   = x + inject_j * F(block_in)  for every stream j
+
+    The interface matches :class:`HyperConnectionModule` so that
+    :class:`~megatron.core.transformer.transformer_layer.HyperConnectionTransformerLayer` drives
+    both formulations: ``forward`` returns ``(block_input, h_res, h_post)`` where ``h_res`` is
+    ``None`` (the residual mixing is the identity) and ``h_post`` is ``inject``, and
+    :meth:`fused_h_res_h_post_bda` applies the write gate. With ``use_combine=False`` the module
+    is the block-level output mixer: it only returns ``block_in`` (see
+    :class:`GatedResidualOutputMixer`).
+
+    Parameters are replicated across tensor-parallel ranks and kept in ``params_dtype`` like the
+    reference checkpoints; the norm statistics run in fp32; gates retain activation-dtype operation boundaries.
+    """
+
+    def __init__(self, config: TransformerConfig, layer_number: int = 1, use_combine: bool = True):
+        super().__init__(config)
+        self.config = config
+        self.layer_number = layer_number
+        self.n = config.mhc_num_residual_streams
+        self.hidden_size = config.hidden_size
+        self.rank = config.mhc_gated_residual_rank
+        self.use_combine = use_combine
+        self.norm_eps = config.layernorm_epsilon
+        hc_hidden_size = self.n * self.hidden_size
+        dtype = config.params_dtype
+
+        self.hc_norm = nn.Module()
+        self.hc_norm.weight = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(hc_hidden_size, dtype=dtype))
+        self.input_mix_weight_down = nn.Linear(hc_hidden_size, self.rank, bias=False, dtype=dtype)
+        self.input_mix_weight_up = nn.Linear(self.rank, hc_hidden_size, bias=False, dtype=dtype)
+        self.block_inject_weight: nn.Linear | None
+        if use_combine:
+            self.block_inject_weight = nn.Linear(hc_hidden_size, self.n, bias=False, dtype=dtype)
+        else:
+            self.block_inject_weight = None
+
+        if self.config.perform_initialization:
+            nn.init.normal_(self.input_mix_weight_down.weight, mean=0.0, std=config.init_method_std)
+            nn.init.normal_(self.input_mix_weight_up.weight, mean=0.0, std=config.init_method_std)
+            if self.block_inject_weight is not None:
+                nn.init.normal_(self.block_inject_weight.weight, mean=0.0, std=config.init_method_std)
+
+        # Replicated (non tensor-parallel) parameters: their gradients must be all-reduced
+        # across the TP group when sequence parallelism shards the tokens.
+        if self.config.sequence_parallel:
+            for param in self.parameters():
+                setattr(param, "sequence_parallel", True)
+
+    def _mix(self, hidden_states: Tensor) -> Tuple[Tensor, Optional[Tensor]]:
+        n = self.n
+        xn = gated_residual_group_rmsnorm(hidden_states, self.hc_norm.weight, n, self.norm_eps)
+        down = activate_residual_gate(self.input_mix_weight_down(xn), n)
+        block_input = mix_residual_streams(self.input_mix_weight_up(down), xn, n)
+        if self.block_inject_weight is None:
+            return block_input, None
+        inject = 2.0 * torch.sigmoid(self.block_inject_weight(xn) / n)  # [s, b, n]
+        return block_input, inject
+
+    def forward(
+        self, hidden_states: Tensor, mhc_recompute_manager: object | None = None, return_residual: bool = False
+    ) -> tuple[Tensor, None, Tensor | None] | tuple[Tensor, None, Tensor | None, Tensor]:
+        """Read the streams.
+
+        Args:
+            hidden_states: [s, b, n*C] n-stream hidden states.
+            mhc_recompute_manager: Accepted for interface compatibility; not used.
+            return_residual: Also return the (unchanged) n-stream residual as a 4th element,
+                like :class:`HyperConnectionModule`.
+
+        Returns:
+            ``(block_input [s, b, C], h_res=None, h_post [s, b, n])``. ``h_post`` is ``None``
+            for the output mixer (``use_combine=False``).
+        """
+        block_input, inject = self._mix(hidden_states)
+        if return_residual:
+            return block_input, None, inject, hidden_states
+        return block_input, None, inject
+
+    def apply_h_res(self, h_res: Optional[Tensor], residual: Tensor) -> Tensor:
+        """The gated residual keeps the streams untouched (identity residual mixing)."""
+        return residual
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _inject(residual: Tensor, inject: Tensor, x: Tensor, bias: Optional[Tensor], n: int) -> Tensor:
+        s, b, nC = residual.shape
+        out = x
+        if bias is not None:
+            out = out + bias
+        update = inject.unsqueeze(-1) * out.unsqueeze(2)  # [s, b, n, C]
+        return (residual.view(s, b, n, -1) + update).view(s, b, nC).to(residual.dtype)
+
+    @nvtx_decorator(message="GatedResidual::fused_h_res_h_post_bda")
+    def fused_h_res_h_post_bda(
+        self,
+        h_res: Optional[Tensor],
+        original_residual: Tensor,
+        h_post: Tensor,
+        layer_output_with_bias: Tuple[Tensor, Optional[Tensor]],
+        dropout_prob: float,
+        training: bool,
+        fused: bool,
+        manager: object | None = None,
+    ) -> Tensor:
+        """Write the sub-layer output back to every stream: ``x + inject_j * (F(x) + bias)``.
+
+        Args:
+            h_res: Unused (identity residual mixing).
+            original_residual: [s, b, n*C] n-stream hidden states before the sub-layer.
+            h_post: [s, b, n] per-stream write gates returned by :meth:`forward`.
+            layer_output_with_bias: ``(x [s, b, C], bias [C] or None)``.
+            dropout_prob / training / fused: bias-dropout-add settings; dropout is applied to the
+                broadcast update when non-zero.
+            manager: Accepted for interface compatibility; not used.
+
+        Returns:
+            [s, b, n*C] updated streams.
+        """
+        x, bias = layer_output_with_bias
+        if dropout_prob == 0.0 or not training:
+            return self._inject(original_residual, h_post, x, bias, self.n)
+        from megatron.core.fusions.fused_bias_dropout import get_bias_dropout_add
+
+        s, b, nC = original_residual.shape
+        x_expanded = (h_post.unsqueeze(-1) * x.float().unsqueeze(2)).view(s, b, nC).to(x.dtype)
+        bias_expanded = (
+            (h_post.unsqueeze(-1) * bias.float().view(1, 1, 1, -1)).view(s, b, nC).to(x.dtype)
+            if bias is not None
+            else None
+        )
+        bda_func = get_bias_dropout_add(training, fused)
+        return bda_func((x_expanded, bias_expanded), original_residual, dropout_prob)
+
+
+class GatedResidualOutputMixer(GatedResidualHyperConnection):
+    """Block-level learned contraction of the Qwen4-Exp residual streams.
+
+    Replaces the final layer norm of a
+    :class:`~megatron.core.transformer.transformer_block.TransformerBlock`
+    built with the Bridge-local Qwen4-Exp layer spec: it consumes the
+    ``[s, b, n*C]`` streams and returns the ``[s, b, C]`` gated mean of their normalized values
+    (``hyper_connection_mixer`` in the HF checkpoint). Core's generic mHC path remains
+    disabled; the local HybridModel expands streams before the decoder so the learned
+    mixer receives every stream without Core's unweighted mean contraction.
+
+    The ``(config, hidden_size, eps)`` signature matches the layer-norm builders used in block
+    specs.
+    """
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        config: TransformerConfig,
+        hidden_size: Optional[int] = None,
+        eps: Optional[float] = None,
+    ) -> None:
+        super().__init__(config, layer_number=0, use_combine=False)
+        if hidden_size is not None:
+            assert hidden_size == config.hidden_size, "GatedResidualOutputMixer mixes full hidden streams."
+        if eps is not None:
+            self.norm_eps = eps
+
+    def forward(self, hidden_states: Tensor) -> Tensor:  # type: ignore[override]
+        """[s, b, n*C] streams -> [s, b, C] mixed output."""
+        block_input, _ = self._mix(hidden_states)
+        return block_input

+"""Preserve Qwen4-Exp activation rounding at gated residual operation boundaries."""
+
+import torch
+import torch.nn.functional as F
+from torch import Tensor
+
+
+def _activate_reference(down: Tensor, streams: int) -> Tensor:
+    return F.silu(down / streams)
+
+
+def _mix_reference(up: Tensor, normalized: Tensor, streams: int) -> Tensor:
+    width = up.shape[-1] // streams
+    gates = up.sigmoid().unflatten(-1, (streams, width))
+    return (gates * normalized.unflatten(-1, (streams, width))).mean(-2)
+
+
+_activate_eager = torch.compiler.disable(_activate_reference)
+_mix_eager = torch.compiler.disable(_mix_reference)
+
+
+def activate_residual_gate(down: Tensor, streams: int) -> Tensor:
+    """Keep the low-precision division store before SiLU, including under compile."""
+    if down.dtype in (torch.float16, torch.bfloat16):
+        return _activate_eager(down, streams)
+    return _activate_reference(down, streams)
+
+
+def mix_residual_streams(up: Tensor, normalized: Tensor, streams: int) -> Tensor:
+    """Keep sigmoid and multiplication stores before the stream mean."""
+    if up.dtype in (torch.float16, torch.bfloat16):
+        return _mix_eager(up, normalized, streams)
+    return _mix_reference(up, normalized, streams)

+"""Qwen4-Exp layer specs using Bridge-local model components."""
+
+from copy import deepcopy
+from dataclasses import fields
+from functools import partial
+from typing import TYPE_CHECKING
+
+from megatron.core.models.backends import get_backend_from_config
+from megatron.core.models.gpt.experimental_attention_variant_module_specs import (
+    get_transformer_layer_with_experimental_attention_variant_spec,
+)
+from megatron.core.models.hybrid.hybrid_block import HybridStackSubmodules

+from megatron.core.transformer.transformer_block import TransformerBlockSubmodules

+
+from megatron.bridge.models.qwen.modeling_qwen4_exp.gated_residual import (
+    GatedResidualHyperConnection,
+    GatedResidualOutputMixer,
+)
+from megatron.bridge.models.qwen.modeling_qwen4_exp.model import (
+    Qwen4ExpGatedDeltaNet,
+    Qwen4ExpHybridStack,
+    Qwen4ExpLayerSubmodules,
+    Qwen4ExpTransformerLayer,
+)
+from megatron.bridge.models.qwen.modeling_qwen4_exp.per_layer_embedding import PerLayerEmbedding
+from megatron.bridge.models.qwen.modeling_qwen4_exp.qsa import (
+    QSACoreAttention,
+    QSAIndexer,
+    QSAIndexerSubmodules,
+    QwenSparseSelfAttention,
+    QwenSparseSelfAttentionSubmodules,
+)
+from megatron.bridge.models.qwen_vl.modelling_qwen3_vl.attention import Qwen3VLSelfAttention
+
+
+if TYPE_CHECKING:
+    from megatron.bridge.models.qwen.modeling_qwen4_exp.model_config import Qwen4ExpTransformerConfig
+
+
+def get_qwen4_exp_block_spec(
+    config: "Qwen4ExpTransformerConfig", vp_stage: int | None = None
+) -> TransformerBlockSubmodules:
+    """Replace family-specific slots in Core's GDN/MoE decoder spec.
+
+    The provider restricts this first migration to PP=CP=1. Tensor parallelism
+    and sequence parallelism retain Core's usual attention/MLP implementations.
+    """
+    if config.pipeline_model_parallel_size != 1 or config.context_parallel_size != 1 or vp_stage is not None:
+        raise NotImplementedError("Qwen4-Exp currently requires PP=CP=1 without virtual pipeline stages.")
+    backend = get_backend_from_config(config)
+    layer_specs = deepcopy(get_transformer_layer_with_experimental_attention_variant_spec(config, backend=backend))
+    ple_layer_ids = set(config.ple_layer_ids or [])
+    for layer_number, spec in enumerate(layer_specs, start=1):
+        spec.module = Qwen4ExpTransformerLayer
+        old = spec.submodules
+        spec.submodules = Qwen4ExpLayerSubmodules(
+            **{field.name: getattr(old, field.name) for field in fields(TransformerLayerSubmodules)}
+        )
+        sub = spec.submodules
+        sub.input_layernorm = IdentityOp
+        sub.pre_mlp_layernorm = IdentityOp
+        sub.self_attention_hyper_connection = GatedResidualHyperConnection
+        sub.mlp_hyper_connection = GatedResidualHyperConnection
+        if layer_number in ple_layer_ids:
+            sub.per_layer_embedding = ModuleSpec(module=PerLayerEmbedding)
+
+        attention = sub.self_attention
+        if hasattr(attention.submodules, "in_proj"):
+            attention.module = Qwen4ExpGatedDeltaNet
+            attention.submodules.in_proj = backend.column_parallel_linear()
+        elif config.qsa_indexer_n_heads is not None:
+            qk_norm = backend.layer_norm(rms_norm=True, for_qk=True) if config.qk_layernorm else IdentityOp
+            sub.self_attention = ModuleSpec(
+                module=QwenSparseSelfAttention,
+                params={"attn_mask_type": AttnMaskType.causal},
+                submodules=QwenSparseSelfAttentionSubmodules(
+                    linear_qkv=backend.column_parallel_linear(),
+                    core_attention=partial(QSACoreAttention, dense_core_attention=backend.core_attention()),
+                    linear_proj=backend.row_parallel_linear(),
+                    q_layernorm=qk_norm,
+                    k_layernorm=qk_norm,
+                    indexer=ModuleSpec(
+                        module=QSAIndexer,
+                        submodules=QSAIndexerSubmodules(
+                            linear_qk=backend.linear(),
+                            q_layernorm=backend.layer_norm(rms_norm=True, for_qk=True),
+                            k_layernorm=backend.layer_norm(rms_norm=True, for_qk=True),
+                        ),
+                    ),
+                ),
+                metainfo={"fuse_input_layernorm": False},
+            )
+        else:
+            if config.qwen4_mrope:
+                attention.module = Qwen3VLSelfAttention
+            attention.submodules.linear_qkv = backend.column_parallel_linear()
+
+        # A dense MLP must not apply a second input norm after GR has normalized
+        # and mixed the streams. MoE uses an unfused input projection already.
+        mlp_submodules = getattr(sub.mlp, "submodules", None)
+        if mlp_submodules is None and isinstance(sub.mlp, partial):
+            mlp_submodules = sub.mlp.keywords.get("submodules")
+        if mlp_submodules is not None and hasattr(mlp_submodules, "linear_fc1"):
+            mlp_submodules.linear_fc1 = backend.column_parallel_linear()
+
+    return TransformerBlockSubmodules(layer_specs=layer_specs, layer_norm=GatedResidualOutputMixer)
+
+
+class Qwen4ExpHybridLayer(Qwen4ExpTransformerLayer):
+    """Select the original complete decoder block at its checkpoint layer index."""
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        config: "Qwen4ExpTransformerConfig",
+        *,
+        layer_specs: list[ModuleSpec],
+        layer_number: int,
+        pg_collection: ProcessGroupCollection,
+        name: str | None = None,
+        **kwargs: object,
+    ) -> None:
+        # Core's per-position config conversion preserves the complete config
+        # state, including the family-specific QSA, PLE and gated residual fields.
+        # PP=1 guarantees the hybrid and original decoder indices are identical.
+        super().__init__(
+            config=config,
+            submodules=layer_specs[layer_number - 1].submodules,
+            layer_number=layer_number,
+            pg_collection=pg_collection,
+            name=name,
+        )
+
+
+def get_qwen4_exp_hybrid_stack_spec(config: "Qwen4ExpTransformerConfig") -> ModuleSpec:
+    """Compose Qwen4-Exp complete decoder blocks inside Core's HybridStack."""
+    block_spec = get_qwen4_exp_block_spec(config)
+    layer_spec = ModuleSpec(
+        module=Qwen4ExpHybridLayer,
+        params={"layer_specs": block_spec.layer_specs},
+    )
+    return ModuleSpec(
+        module=Qwen4ExpHybridStack,
+        submodules=HybridStackSubmodules(attention_layer=layer_spec, gdn_layer=layer_spec),
+    )

+"""Qwen4-Exp integration with the unmodified Megatron-Core Hybrid decoder."""
+
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from typing import TYPE_CHECKING
+
+import torch
+from megatron.core import tensor_parallel
+from megatron.core.inference.contexts import BaseInferenceContext
+from megatron.core.models.hybrid.hybrid_block import HybridStack, HybridStackSubmodules
+from megatron.core.models.hybrid.hybrid_model import HybridModel
+from megatron.core.packed_seq_params import PackedSeqParams
+from megatron.core.ssm.gated_delta_net import GatedDeltaNet

+from megatron.core.transformer.spec_utils import ModuleSpec, build_module
+from megatron.core.transformer.transformer_layer import HyperConnectionTransformerLayer, TransformerLayerSubmodules
+
+from megatron.bridge.models.qwen.modeling_qwen4_exp.gated_residual import GatedResidualOutputMixer
+from megatron.bridge.models.qwen_vl.modelling_qwen3_vl.rope import Qwen3VLMultimodalRotaryEmbedding
+
+
+if TYPE_CHECKING:
+    from megatron.bridge.models.qwen.modeling_qwen4_exp.model_config import Qwen4ExpTransformerConfig
+
+
+@dataclass
+class Qwen4ExpLayerSubmodules(TransformerLayerSubmodules):
+    """Core layer submodules plus the model-specific lexical embedding."""
+
+    per_layer_embedding: ModuleSpec | type = IdentityOp
+
+
+class Qwen4ExpTransformerLayer(HyperConnectionTransformerLayer):
+    """Inject PLE before reading the gated residual streams."""
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        config: "Qwen4ExpTransformerConfig",
+        submodules: Qwen4ExpLayerSubmodules,
+        *args: object,
+        **kwargs: object,
+    ) -> None:
+        super().__init__(config, submodules, *args, **kwargs)
+        self.per_layer_embedding = None
+        if submodules.per_layer_embedding is not IdentityOp:
+            self.per_layer_embedding = build_module(
+                submodules.per_layer_embedding,
+                config=config,
+                layer_number=self.layer_number,
+                pg_collection=self.pg_collection,
+            )
+
+    def _forward_attention(
+        self, hidden_states: torch.Tensor, *args: object, **kwargs: object
+    ) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor | None]:
+        if self.per_layer_embedding is not None:
+            hidden_states = hidden_states + self.per_layer_embedding(hidden_states)
+        return super()._forward_attention(hidden_states, *args, **kwargs)
+
+
+class Qwen4ExpGatedDeltaNet(GatedDeltaNet):
+    """Keep the SiLU convolution while using a separate sigmoid output gate."""
+
+    def _apply_gated_norm(self, x: torch.Tensor, gate: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+        x_dtype = x.dtype
+        normalized = self.out_norm(x.reshape(-1, x.shape[-1]))
+        gate = gate.reshape(-1, gate.shape[-1]).float()
+        if self.config.linear_attention_output_gate_activation == "sigmoid":
+            gate = torch.sigmoid(gate)
+        else:
+            gate = self.act_fn(gate)
+        return (normalized * gate).to(x_dtype)
+
+
+class Qwen4ExpHybridStack(HybridStack):
+    """Core hybrid execution with Qwen4-Exp's learned output stream mixer."""
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        config: "Qwen4ExpTransformerConfig",
+        submodules: HybridStackSubmodules,
+        **kwargs: object,
+    ) -> None:
+        super().__init__(config, submodules, post_layer_norm=False, **kwargs)
+        self.post_layer_norm = True
+        if self.post_process:
+            self.final_norm = GatedResidualOutputMixer(config)
+
+
+class _Qwen4ExpMultimodalRotaryEmbedding(Qwen3VLMultimodalRotaryEmbedding):
+    """Adapt explicit VLM positions to HybridModel's rotary invocation."""
+
+    position_ids: torch.Tensor | None = None
+    packed_seq_params: PackedSeqParams | None = None
+
+    def forward(self, max_seq_len: int, *, packed_seq: bool = False) -> torch.Tensor:
+        if self.position_ids is None:
+            raise ValueError("Qwen4-Exp multimodal rotary embedding requires position_ids.")
+        return super().forward(self.position_ids, self.mrope_section, self.packed_seq_params)
+
+
+class Qwen4ExpHybridModel(HybridModel):
+    """Prepare lexical inputs and residual streams for the Core Hybrid decoder.
+
+    Every hybrid position keeps the original attention-plus-MLP decoder block,
+    including both gated residual connections. PLE layer numbers and checkpoint
+    parameter indices therefore remain unchanged.
+    """
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        config: "Qwen4ExpTransformerConfig",
+        *,
+        rotary_percent: float,
+        rotary_base: int,
+        mrope_section: list[int] | None = None,
+        seq_len_interpolation_factor: float | None = None,
+        **kwargs: object,
+    ) -> None:
+        super().__init__(
+            config=config,
+            rotary_percent=rotary_percent,
+            rotary_base=rotary_base,
+            seq_len_interpolation_factor=seq_len_interpolation_factor,
+            **kwargs,
+        )
+        if mrope_section is not None:
+            self.rotary_pos_emb = _Qwen4ExpMultimodalRotaryEmbedding(
+                kv_channels=self.config.kv_channels,
+                rotary_percent=rotary_percent,
+                rotary_interleaved=self.config.rotary_interleaved,
+                rotary_base=rotary_base,
+                seq_len_interpolation_factor=seq_len_interpolation_factor,
+                cp_group=self.pg_collection.cp,
+            )
+            self.rotary_pos_emb.mrope_section = mrope_section
+
+    def forward(
+        self,
+        input_ids: torch.Tensor,
+        position_ids: torch.Tensor,
+        attention_mask: torch.Tensor | None,
+        decoder_input: torch.Tensor | None = None,
+        labels: torch.Tensor | None = None,
+        inference_context: BaseInferenceContext | None = None,
+        runtime_gather_output: bool | None = None,
+        *,
+        packed_seq_params: PackedSeqParams | None = None,
+        padding_mask: torch.Tensor | None = None,
+        **kwargs: object,
+    ) -> torch.Tensor:
+        """Execute the language decoder, retaining raw IDs for PLE with VLM embeddings."""
+        if padding_mask is not None:
+            raise NotImplementedError("Qwen4-Exp padding masks are not supported yet; use packed inputs.")
+        if inference_context is not None or kwargs.get("inference_params") is not None:
+            raise NotImplementedError("Qwen4-Exp does not support cached inference yet.")
+        if self.config.ple_layer_ids:
+            if input_ids is None:
+                raise ValueError("Qwen4-Exp PLE requires raw input_ids, including with decoder_input.")
+            cu_seqlens = None
+            if packed_seq_params is not None and packed_seq_params.qkv_format == "thd":
+                cu_seqlens = packed_seq_params.cu_seqlens_q_padded
+                if cu_seqlens is None:
+                    cu_seqlens = packed_seq_params.cu_seqlens_q
+            for layer in self.decoder.layers:
+                if layer.per_layer_embedding is not None:

+class Qwen4ExpModelBuilder(HybridModelBuilder):
+    """Build the Bridge-local blocks through the Core HybridModel API."""
+
+    def build_model(
+        self,
+        pg_collection: ProcessGroupCollection,
+        pre_process: bool | None = None,
+        post_process: bool | None = None,
+        vp_stage: int | None = None,
+    ) -> Qwen4ExpHybridModel:
+        """Build a complete PP=CP=1 language decoder with explicit process groups."""
+        config = self._model_config
+        config.finalize()
+        if vp_stage is not None or pre_process is False or post_process is False:
+            raise NotImplementedError("Qwen4-Exp requires a complete decoder on each PP=1 rank.")
+        if pg_collection is None:
+            raise ValueError("Qwen4-Exp requires an explicit process-group collection.")
+        if config.vocab_size is None:

+"""Declarative configuration for the Bridge-local Qwen4-Exp HybridModel."""
+
+import warnings
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from typing import Any, ClassVar
+
+from megatron.bridge.models.common.base import ModelConfig, ModelConfigOverrideMixin

+class Qwen4ExpTransformerConfig(TransformerConfig):
+    """Transformer settings for QSA, gated residuals and lexical embeddings."""
+
+    # Derived from the outer config for conversion helpers that inspect model.config.
+    share_embeddings_and_output_weights: bool = False
+    qwen4_mrope: bool = False
+    apply_rotary_pos_emb_in_fp32: bool = False
+    linear_attention_output_gate_activation: str | None = None
+    mhc_variant: str = "gated_residual"
+    mhc_gated_residual_rank: int | None = None
+    qsa_indexer_n_heads: int | None = None
+    qsa_indexer_kv_heads: int = 1
+    qsa_indexer_head_dim: int | None = None
+    qsa_indexer_budget: int | None = None
+    qsa_indexer_compress_ratio: int | None = None
+    qsa_force_sparse: bool = False
+    ple_layer_ids: list[int] | None = None
+    ple_embed_dim: int | None = None
+    ple_conv_kernel_size: int = 4
+    ple_ngram_size: int = 3
+    ple_heads_per_ngram: int = 8
+    ple_ngram_vocab_size_base: int = 20_000_000
+    ple_ngram_vocab_divisible_by: int = 128
+    ple_seed: int = 1234

+    ple_unigram_vocab_size: int | None = None

+@dataclass(kw_only=True)
+class Qwen4ExpModelConfig(ModelConfigOverrideMixin, HybridModelConfig, ModelConfig):
+    """Build settings with one complete attention/MLP block per hybrid position."""
+
+    builder: ClassVar[str] = "megatron.bridge.models.qwen.modeling_qwen4_exp.Qwen4ExpModelBuilder"
+    transformer_config_class: ClassVar[type[TransformerConfig]] = Qwen4ExpTransformerConfig
+    hybrid_attention_layers_include_mlp: ClassVar[bool] = True
+    position_embedding_type: str = "rope"

+    hf_model_text_only: bool = False
+    bos_token_id: int | None = None
+    eos_token_id: int | None = None
+    hetereogenous_dist_checkpoint: bool = True

+    def _validate_qwen4_exp(self) -> None:
+        if self.enable_mhc_connections:
+            raise ValueError("Disable Core mHC expansion/contraction for the local Qwen4-Exp model.")
+        if self.pipeline_model_parallel_size != 1 or self.context_parallel_size != 1:
+            raise NotImplementedError("Qwen4-Exp currently requires PP=CP=1.")
+        if self.virtual_pipeline_model_parallel_size is not None:
+            raise NotImplementedError("Qwen4-Exp virtual pipeline stages are not supported.")
+        if self.cuda_graph_impl != "none" or self.recompute_granularity is not None:
+            raise NotImplementedError("Qwen4-Exp CUDA graphs and activation recomputation are not supported yet.")
+        if self.vision_recompute_granularity is not None:
+            raise NotImplementedError("Qwen4-Exp vision recomputation is not supported yet.")
+        if self.mhc_recompute_layer_num is not None:
+            raise NotImplementedError("Core mHC recomputation is not supported by Qwen4-Exp gated residuals.")
+        if self.mtp_num_layers or self.fp8:
+            raise NotImplementedError("Qwen4-Exp MTP and FP8 are not supported yet.")
+        if (
+            self.mhc_variant != "gated_residual"
+            or not self.mhc_gated_residual_rank
+            or self.mhc_gated_residual_rank < 1
+        ):

+        if self.mhc_num_residual_streams < 1:
+            raise ValueError("Qwen4-Exp requires at least one residual stream.")
+        if self.linear_attention_output_gate_activation not in (None, "silu", "sigmoid"):
+            raise ValueError("Qwen4-Exp output gate must be silu or sigmoid.")
+        if self.qsa_indexer_n_heads is not None:
+            for name in (
+                "qsa_indexer_n_heads",
+                "qsa_indexer_head_dim",
+                "qsa_indexer_budget",
+                "qsa_indexer_compress_ratio",
+            ):
+                value = getattr(self, name)
+                if value is None or value <= 0:
+                    raise ValueError(f"Qwen4-Exp requires a positive {name}.")
+            if self.qsa_indexer_kv_heads != 1:
+                raise ValueError("QSA requires one indexer key head.")
+            # Narrow optional checkpoint fields after validating them above.
+            assert self.qsa_indexer_budget is not None
+            assert self.qsa_indexer_compress_ratio is not None
+            assert self.qsa_indexer_head_dim is not None
+            if self.qsa_indexer_budget % self.qsa_indexer_compress_ratio:
+                raise ValueError("QSA budget must be divisible by its compression ratio.")
+            if int(self.kv_channels * self.rotary_percent) > self.qsa_indexer_head_dim:
+                raise ValueError("The attention RoPE width must fit in the QSA indexer head.")
+        if self.ple_layer_ids:

+                raise ValueError("PLE layer IDs must be unique; their order defines the hash-table layout.")
+            if any(layer < 1 or layer > self.num_layers for layer in self.ple_layer_ids):
+                raise ValueError("PLE layer IDs must be one-indexed decoder layer numbers.")
+            if self.ple_eos_token_id is None or not self.ple_unigram_vocab_size or self.ple_unigram_vocab_size < 1:

+            heads = (self.ple_ngram_size - 1) * self.ple_heads_per_ngram
+            if heads < 1 or (self.ple_embed_dim or self.hidden_size) % heads:
+                raise ValueError("PLE embedding width must be divisible by its n-gram head count.")
+            if min(self.ple_conv_kernel_size, self.ple_ngram_vocab_size_base, self.ple_ngram_vocab_divisible_by) < 1:

+

+        self._validate_qwen4_exp()
+        if self.position_embedding_type != "rope":
+            raise ValueError("Qwen4-Exp requires rotary position embeddings.")
+        frequency = self.linear_attention_freq
+        if isinstance(frequency, int):
+            if frequency < 1:
+                raise ValueError("linear_attention_freq must be positive.")
+            frequency = [int((i + 1) % frequency != 0) for i in range(self.num_layers)]
+        if (
+            not isinstance(frequency, list)
+            or len(frequency) != self.num_layers
+            or any(value not in (0, 1) for value in frequency)
+        ):
+            raise ValueError("linear_attention_freq must select one attention type per decoder layer.")
+        pattern = "".join("G" if value else "*" for value in frequency)
+        if self.hybrid_layer_pattern is not None and self.hybrid_layer_pattern != pattern:
+            raise ValueError("hybrid_layer_pattern must match the linear_attention_freq schedule.")
+        self.hybrid_layer_pattern = pattern
+        if self.hybrid_override_pattern is not None or self.hybrid_attention_ratio or self.hybrid_mlp_ratio:
+            raise ValueError("Use the Qwen4-Exp linear_attention_freq schedule rather than hybrid ratios.")
+        if self.mrope_section is not None:
+            width = int(self.kv_channels * self.rotary_percent)
+            if len(self.mrope_section) != 3 or sum(self.mrope_section) * 2 != width:
+                raise ValueError("mrope_section must partition the rotary head dimension into three axes.")
+
+    def _get_additional_transformer_flops(self, *, seqlen_sum: int | float) -> int | float:
+        """Count custom projection work beyond the generic GDN/MoE estimate.
+
+        Counts logical model matrix FLOPs, not TP-replicated execution or
+        hardware instructions. Trainable GR/PLE projections use six FLOPs per
+        weight per token (forward, input gradient and weight gradient); the
+        hard-selection QSA indexer has forward-only work. Norms, activations,
+        embedding lookups, PLE depthwise convolution and communication remain
+        outside this matrix estimate. While every visible QSA block is selected,
+        the native shape shortcut skips the entire indexer. Outside that configured
+        length bound the inherited dense attention term is only a surrogate;
+        warn rather than restricting otherwise supported model training.
+        """
+        if seqlen_sum < 0:
+            raise ValueError("Qwen4 FLOPs require a nonnegative runtime token count.")
+        hidden = self.hidden_size
+        streams = self.mhc_num_residual_streams
+        rank = self.mhc_gated_residual_rank
+        if self.mhc_variant != "gated_residual" or rank is None or rank <= 0:
+            raise ValueError("Qwen4 FLOPs require the gated-residual architecture.")
+        stream_width = streams * hidden
+        # Two GR modules per complete layer; final output mixer has no inject.
+        gr_weights = 2 * self.num_layers * (2 * stream_width * rank + stream_width * streams)
+        gr_weights += 2 * stream_width * rank
+        ple_weights = len(self.ple_layer_ids or ()) * (self.ple_embed_dim or hidden) * (stream_width + hidden)
+        training_flops = 6 * (gr_weights + ple_weights)
+        indexer_flops = 0
+        if self.qsa_indexer_n_heads is not None:
+            if (
+                self.qsa_force_sparse
+                or self.qsa_indexer_budget is None
+                or self.qsa_indexer_compress_ratio is None
+                or self.seq_length <= 0
+                or self.seq_length > self.qsa_indexer_budget + self.qsa_indexer_compress_ratio - 1
+            ):
+                warnings.warn(
+                    "Qwen4 FLOPs use a dense-attention surrogate outside the QSA selection shortcut; "
+                    "sparse attention and indexer score work are not accurately accounted for.",
+                    UserWarning,
+                    stacklevel=2,
+                )
+                frequency = self.linear_attention_freq
+                if isinstance(frequency, int):
+                    attention_layers = self.num_layers // frequency
+                else:
+                    attention_layers = self.num_layers - sum(frequency)
+                # Outside the shape shortcut the detached indexer projections run
+                # forward only; selector score work remains unaccounted above.
+                indexer_flops = (
+                    2
+                    * hidden
+                    * (self.qsa_indexer_n_heads + self.qsa_indexer_kv_heads)
+                    * self.qsa_indexer_head_dim
+                    * attention_layers
+                )
+        return seqlen_sum * (training_flops + indexer_flops)
+
+    def as_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
+        """Serialize the config with a symbolic activation function."""
+        data = super().as_dict()
+        transformer_data = data.get("transformer")
+        if not isinstance(transformer_data, dict):
+            raise TypeError("Serialized Qwen4-Exp model config must contain a transformer mapping.")
+
+        activation_func = self.transformer.activation_func
+        if isinstance(activation_func, str):
+            str_to_callable(activation_func)
+            activation_name = activation_func
+        else:
+            activation_name = callable_to_str(activation_func)
+        if activation_name is None:
+            raise ValueError(f"Cannot serialize unregistered activation callable: {activation_func!r}.")
+
+        transformer_data["activation_func"] = activation_name
+        return data
+
+    @classmethod
+    def from_dict(cls, data: dict[str, Any]) -> "Qwen4ExpModelConfig":
+        """Deserialize a config while restoring its activation callable."""
+        restored_data = dict(data)
+        transformer_data = restored_data.get("transformer")
+        if isinstance(transformer_data, dict):
+            restored_transformer = dict(transformer_data)
+            activation_name = restored_transformer.get("activation_func")
+            if isinstance(activation_name, str):
+                restored_transformer["activation_func"] = str_to_callable(activation_name)
+            restored_data["transformer"] = restored_transformer
+
+        result = ModelConfig.from_dict(restored_data)
+        if not isinstance(result, cls):
+            raise TypeError(f"Expected {cls.__name__}, got {type(result).__name__}.")
+        return result
